newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
President Jiang Zemin meets Comoros President Mohamed Taki
Politburo member Hu Jintao urges nation to follow theories of Deng Xiaoping
Politburo member Li Ruihuan urges democratic parties to boost cooperation with Communist Party
Import and Export Bank of China guarantees $470 million in export credits
President of Shanghai Stock Exchange urges steady development of exchanges
President of Shenzhen Stock Exchange calls for greater confidence
Tax revenues grow 17 percent in first 11 months
